name: powerful-plugins
description: Plugins for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, built by the StackOne team for anyone to use: design and data visualization, natural writing, code review loops, browser automation and recording, session reflection, spoken notifications and conversation export.

plugins.name: animation-studio
plugins.description: Plan and build web animations and short videos with Motion, anime.js and Remotion, starting from a rough spec.

plugins.name: decision-artifacts
plugins.description: Turn findings, options, plans and status into concise, evidence-backed interactive pages that help people decide.

plugins.name: tufte-viz
plugins.description: Design and critique charts with Edward Tufte's principles: data-ink ratio, no chartjunk, graphical integrity, small multiples and sparklines.

plugins.name: natural-writing
plugins.description: Write and edit like a person, not a language model: bans the words, sentence patterns and formatting that give AI text away, with a mechanical checker and a review command.

plugins.name: browser-recorder
plugins.description: Capture screenshots and video clips (60fps by default) from a shot list, signed in once per domain, with a click and scroll log for video post-processing.

plugins.name: spark
plugins.description: Find the most useful next addition to a change, pressure-test plans and implementations, and run read-only simplification audits across a codebase.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Learn from the current session or from recurring history across sessions, git changes and review feedback, and propose evidence-backed skill and guidance improvements.

plugins.name: review-loop
plugins.description: Get a PR through every AI code reviewer on it: trigger each, verify and fix or decline each comment, repeat until all are clean.

plugins.name: browser-automation
plugins.description: Drive a browser with the coding agent's own browser first (Claude in Chrome, Codex's Chrome or in-app Browser), falling back to agent-browser, Playwright or Chrome DevTools only when the job needs them.

plugins.name: cc-print
plugins.description: Export Claude Code and Codex conversations to terminal-styled PNG, SVG, PDF or HTML.

plugins.name: say-hooks
plugins.description: Speak when Claude Code or Codex finishes a turn or is blocked, with offline stackvox voices or the macOS say fallback.

plugins.name: agent-browser
plugins.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents - interact with and test code in Chromium using natural language

plugins.name: pr-review-toolkit
plugins.description: Comprehensive PR review with specialized agents for code review, silent failure hunting, and test analysis

plugins.name: remotion-best-practices
plugins.description: Best practices for Remotion - React-based video creation. Covers compositions, animations, media handling, Three.js 3D, captions, TailwindCSS, and 27 rule files

plugins.name: vercel-web-design-guidelines
plugins.description: Comprehensive web design audit tool with 100+ rules covering accessibility, performance, and UX

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create, test and improve agent skills, with an eval loop and description tuning
